notes: The layout NatWest Group has used since mid-2023 (the older one had CRLF, a blank first line, a blank line after the header, DD/MM/YYYY and every cell quoted). Newest first; dates "DD Mon YYYY"; one signed Value; running Balance; no thousands mark; only a description containing commas is quoted; Account Number is sort code (no dashes) + "-" + account number. No currency named. LF, ASCII.
